cohort: The study included 277 neonates (60.6% female, 39.4% male) whose ultrasound studies were retrieved from the Security Forces Hospital in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, between January 2020 and June 2023.
finding: The incidence of DDH in Makkah was 8.05 per 1000 live births by clinical examination and 2.13 per 1000 live births by selective ultrasound; prematurity significantly increased DDH risk, and breech presentation increased the risk approximately fourfold.
